data.name: Charlie
data.message: Working on O2 filter, want to buddy up?

data.name: Bob
data.message: Sure, let's buddy up! Doing O2 filter now.

data.name: Eve
data.message: Calibrating distributor here, want to buddy up?

data.name: Charlie
data.message: One more tick on O2, then heading to upper engine if you want to come along

data.name: Bob
data.message: One more tick then I'll join you to upper engine, then I need medbay

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Heading to upper engine now, come with?

Frank’s body was in medbay, right by the scan area. I came from electrical toward medbay and reported as soon as I saw it. Eve was the only person I saw around there — she had been in electrical with me earlier after coming from medbay, then she was in medbay when I found the body. I’m not hard accusing yet, but Eve definitely needs to explain that route.

Okay, let me lay out my actual route because Diana's got it twisted. I started in medbay, moved to electrical, and saw Diana there at ticks 2 and 3. Then at tick 4 Diana left electrical heading to medbay — I stayed behind. I came back to medbay later and that's when the meeting was called.

So Diana saying I was "in medbay when she found the body" — sure, at the meeting, but she's the one who walked from electrical INTO medbay where Frank ended up dead. I was in electrical when she left. She had the opportunity, not me. If Frank was killed in medbay around when Diana arrived there, that points at her, not me.

I'd like to hear from Alice, Bob, and Charlie about where they were. Diana's story conveniently puts her "discovering" a body in a room she just walked into alone.

I was in upper engine at the start, then moved to oxygen where I've been doing my Clean O2 Filter task. Charlie was with me in oxygen at ticks 2 and 3, then left toward upper engine at tick 4. So Charlie can vouch for me being in oxygen the whole time, and I can vouch for Charlie being nowhere near medbay during those ticks.

I didn't see Frank, Diana, or Eve at all this round — I was on the opposite side of the map. So I can't directly confirm either of their stories. But what I can say is: the two of them were both near medbay, and one of them is lying. Diana walked from electrical into medbay and reported. Eve says she went medbay -> electrical -> medbay. Both routes put them at the crime scene.

I'd really like to hear Alice and Charlie's accounts before deciding. Charlie can at least confirm my alibi. Right now I'm leaning slightly toward Eve because her route has her bouncing back to medbay right when the body shows up, but I'm not locked in.

I'll be straightforward: I was on the far east side the whole round. Started in navigation, moved up to security where I am now. I didn't see anyone — no players, no body, nothing. So I can't directly confirm or deny anyone's story.

What I can do is analyze what's been said. Bob and Charlie alibi each other in oxygen/upper engine, so that side of the map looks clean. That leaves Diana and Eve, both of whom place themselves at or near medbay around the time Frank died.

Eve's route is medbay → electrical → medbay. Diana's route is electrical → medbay (where she reports). The key detail: Eve admits she started in medbay with Frank potentially there, then came back to medbay later. Diana walked in and immediately found the body and reported — that's actually the behavior of someone who didn't do it, because a Duck reporting their own kill is risky when there's a witness chain.

Also, Eve was the LAST person confirmed in medbay before Diana arrived to find the body, by her own admission she returned to medbay. That's suspicious timing.

I'm leaning Eve. Let's hear Charlie confirm Bob's alibi and then I think Eve is our best vote.

Confirming Bob's alibi: I was in oxygen with him at ticks 2 and 3, then moved to upper engine at tick 4. Bob was still in oxygen when I left, doing his O2 filter task. So Bob and I clear each other, and neither of us was anywhere near medbay.

That leaves Diana and Eve as the only candidates, and Alice's analysis lines up with mine. Eve's route — medbay → electrical → medbay — means she was in medbay with Frank at the start and returned right around when the body was found. Diana walking in and immediately reporting is hard to fake with Eve as a live witness in the area; a Duck wouldn't usually self-report into a clean witness.

Also, Eve's pivot to "Diana did it" feels like deflection when her own route puts her in medbay both before and after the kill window.

I'm voting Eve.

Eve, I’m not twisting it — you literally came from medbay into electrical at the start, then were with me in electrical, and when I went to medbay Frank was dead there. When the report happened, you were back in medbay too.

So from my POV the only people with access around that timing were you and me, and I know I walked in and reported immediately. Bob/Charlie are basically cleared on the left side, Alice was far east, so this is just between us.

Your route has you at medbay before and after, and Frank’s body is exactly there. I think Eve is the vote.

Look, I've already laid out my route once and people are spinning it against me, so let me make this crystal clear.

I was in medbay at tick 1, moved to electrical at tick 2, stayed in electrical at tick 3 with Diana the whole time. At tick 4 Diana left electrical heading toward medbay — alone. I did NOT return to medbay before the meeting; the meeting was called while I was still moving back. Diana walked into medbay alone and "found" Frank dead.

Alice and Charlie keep saying "a Duck wouldn't self-report with a witness" — but I'm not a witness to the kill, I'm only a witness that Diana went to medbay alone right before reporting. That's exactly the kind of self-report a Duck WOULD make: kill in the room you just entered, immediately report, and pin it on the person you were last with.

Frank was alive in medbay when I LEFT at tick 2. Diana went to medbay at tick 4. The kill happened in that window — and Diana is the one who walked in there alone.

Bob, Charlie, Alice — I get that my route sounds bad on paper, but think about the timing. Diana is the only one with confirmed solo access to medbay at the kill window. Voting me out hands the game to her.

I'm voting Diana.

I already gave my speech earlier, but since Eve's pushed back hard, let me weigh in again briefly.

Eve, your defense is actually coherent — if you genuinely didn't make it back to medbay before the meeting, then Diana walking in alone is the suspicious move. But here's the thing: Diana says you WERE in medbay when the report happened. That's a direct contradiction, and one of you is lying about it.

Diana's story has her finding the body immediately after entering — which, as Alice said, is risky for a Duck when there's a witness who knows you went there alone. Eve's story has her conveniently "still traveling" during the kill window with no one to confirm it.

Honestly, both are plausible. But Eve being in medbay at tick 1 with Frank, then returning toward medbay, gives her two windows of opportunity. Diana only has one, and she used it to report.

I'm leaning Eve, same as before. Charlie and Alice landed there too. Let's not split the vote.

I'll keep this short since I've already laid out my reasoning. Eve's defense actually has one weak point that stands out: she claims she was "still traveling" back to medbay when the meeting was called, but Diana places her in medbay at the report. That's a direct contradiction — and since respawns haven't happened yet, one of them is provably lying about Eve's location at the moment of the report.

Diana's behavior — walking in, immediately reporting with Eve as a known recent occupant of medbay — is the riskier play for a Duck. Eve's route puts her in medbay at tick 1 with Frank alive, then returning toward medbay right at the kill window.

Bob and Charlie alibi each other, I was on the far east, so it's between Diana and Eve. I'm sticking with Eve. Let's not split the vote.

I've already given my main speech, so I'll keep this tight since I'm closing us out.

The contradiction Alice and Bob both flagged is the key: Diana says Eve was in medbay at the report, Eve says she was still traveling. One of them is lying about a verifiable fact. Combined with Eve's route putting her in medbay at tick 1 with Frank alive AND heading back toward medbay at the kill window, that's two opportunities versus Diana's one — and Diana used hers to immediately report with a known recent occupant as a witness, which is a bad Duck play.

Bob and I clear each other on the west side, Alice was far east. The math points at Eve.

Voting Eve. Everyone please lock it in so we don't split.

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Just finished align engine. Heading to lower engine to fuel - want to buddy up?

data.name: Bob
data.message: Hey Alice, doing my medbay scan. Want to buddy up after?

data.name: Alice
data.message: Sure, I'm heading to storage for cargo then upper engine. Come with?

data.name: Alice
data.message: Heading to security to finish cameras, want to buddy up?

data.name: Bob
data.message: All my tasks done, heading to cafeteria

I found Alice's body in electrical. Here's my route: I started in oxygen with Charlie (saw him there ticks 2-3), then went cafeteria -> medbay (saw Alice alive in medbay at tick 10) -> electrical where I found Alice's body -> security -> weapons (Charlie was there at tick 27, came in from security) -> back to cafeteria where I called this meeting.

So we're down to me, Charlie, and Diana. One of you is the Duck. Diana, where were you this whole round? Charlie, I saw you in oxygen early and weapons late — what were you doing in between? That's the gap where Alice could've been killed in electrical.

Wait, Bob, I’m confused by your own story — you’re saying you found Alice’s body in electrical, then left it, went security -> weapons -> cafeteria, and called button instead of reporting? That’s really weird.

My route was lower engine -> upper engine -> oxygen -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage, then toward medbay/electrical area. I saw Charlie in upper engine around tick 9, and I saw Eve/Frank earlier around medbay/electrical before the first meeting stuff. Late round I saw Alice around the medbay/electrical side, but I didn’t see a body there when I passed through.

If Bob actually saw Alice dead and didn’t report, that’s the biggest red flag here. Charlie has a gap, sure, but Bob is admitting he was at the body and chose not to report it.

Okay, let me lay out what I actually did and what I saw, because both of you are pointing at me.

My route was: upper engine -> lower engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons. I was in upper engine early, saw Diana come in from lower engine around tick 9. Then I went down to lower engine, across to storage, up to medbay, into electrical, security, and finally weapons where Bob says he saw me.

Here's the critical part: I went THROUGH electrical on my way to security. I did NOT see Alice's body there when I passed through. So either Alice was killed in electrical AFTER I left — which fits Bob's story of finding her there later — or Bob is lying about where he found the body.

Now, Diana makes a really strong point. Bob says he found Alice's body in electrical, then walked security -> weapons -> cafeteria and rang the BUTTON instead of just hitting report right there on the body. That makes zero sense for a Goose. You report on the spot. The only reason to walk away from a body is to establish distance or to fake a route.

Also, Bob claims he saw me in oxygen ticks 2-3. I was never in oxygen this round. My route started in upper engine. That's a fabricated alibi placement.

I'm voting Bob.

Hold on, let me address Charlie's points directly because he's twisting this.

First, on the "why didn't you report on the body" — I panicked, plain and simple. I saw Alice dead in electrical, and I didn't know if the killer was still nearby. I moved through security to weapons and that's where I ran into Charlie coming in from security. Think about that: Charlie came into weapons FROM security, which is right next to electrical. He had just been in that exact area. I didn't feel safe reporting alone in a room next to where a kill just happened with Charlie right there, so I went back to cafeteria and hit the button. Not ideal, but that's the truth.

Second, Charlie says he was "never in oxygen." That's a flat lie. I saw him in oxygen at ticks 2 and 3 — I started my route there. He's now denying it because admitting it breaks his clean little "upper engine -> lower engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons" route. If he lied about oxygen, what else is he lying about?

Third — and this is the key one — Charlie just admitted he walked through electrical right before I got there. He's placing himself at the crime scene with perfect timing. "I went through electrical and didn't see a body" is exactly what the killer would say.

Diana's route is long but consistent and she was nowhere near electrical at the kill window. Charlie was. And he's lying about oxygen.

I'm voting Charlie.

Bob, that explanation still doesn’t sit right with me.

If you were a Goose and you actually found Alice’s body in electrical, reporting is the safest possible thing — it instantly stops the round. Running away through security, weapons, then cafeteria gives the killer more time and also hides the real timing/location. That’s exactly the kind of thing a Duck would do after seeing or making a body.

Also your “Charlie was right there” reasoning doesn’t line up: you said you saw him later in weapons, not standing over the body in electrical. So why not report immediately?

And the oxygen thing is a direct contradiction. Charlie says he was never there, you’re insisting you saw him there. One of you is lying, but combined with you admitting you walked away from Alice’s body, I think the worse story is Bob’s.

I’m voting Bob.

Alright, last speaker, let me tie this together.

Bob just changed his story. In his first speech he said he "started in oxygen with Charlie" and saw me there ticks 2-3. But here's the thing — I was never in oxygen. I started in upper engine. So either Bob is misremembering, or he's lying to plant me near his starting location.

Wait — actually, checking my own memory: I did see Bob in oxygen at ticks 2-4. So Bob WAS in oxygen early. But I wasn't with him. He's putting me there to fabricate a shared alibi that doesn't exist, probably to make himself look like he had a witness.

More importantly, Bob's "I panicked and didn't report" excuse is garbage. Reporting a body ENDS the round instantly and is safer than running through three rooms. And his logic — "I didn't feel safe reporting with Charlie nearby in weapons" — makes no sense because hitting report teleports everyone to a meeting immediately. There's no danger in reporting.

Diana's route is long but internally consistent, and I can confirm I saw her transition from lower engine to upper engine at tick 9, which matches her story exactly. She's got a confirmed movement that lines up.

Bob has: a body he walked away from, a fabricated claim about me being in oxygen, and a panic excuse that doesn't hold water.

I'm voting Bob.
